<ic>To elect a Quartermaster<br><br><i>Administrative Motion.</i></ic> 

===Overview===
* This motion was to choose a citizen to appoint as [[Quartermaster_General_of_the_Imperial_Armies|Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies]].
* The candidates were drawn from a short list voted on by the Military Council

===Date===
* Autumn 379YE.

===Campaign Outcome===
* Brendan Brackensong was elected.
